[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 40 (Hard, [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molten Monster''', also called '''Experiment #32''' on [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], is a unit that can be spawned by the [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|consumable of the same name]]. It also used to be spawned on [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] on Wave 40 of the Hard difficulty and Wave 25 of the Easy difficulty while that map was still in the game. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. In [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], it would always start on the middle path. The '''Molten Monster''' has two attacks. The first is its fireball attack, which makes it fire a fireball at an enemy in its range of 50, dealing 1,500 damage to them in a large explosion and setting them all on fire. This has no damage drop off but it does not bypass defense. Its second attack is a swipe which deals 600 damage to all enemies in its swipe range of 12. It attacks enemies in a circular sector, dealing damage to them all and setting them all on fire. Its burn deals 500 damage every 0.5 second for 2.5 seconds, making it deal 2,500 damage total. This also drops enemy defense by 15% every tick, reducing it by up to 50%. None of its attacks actually damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, though its burn and collision damage is able to damage them. It can also detect [[Flying]] enemies, though it is unable to detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. The '''Molten Monster''' cannot be frozen. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Monster''' is a bipedal beast with a glowing reddish-orange interior and a metallic-looking skeletal exterior. It bares long claws on its hands and feet. It has a ribcage around its torso, which is connected to its skinny hind legs. It has shoulder plates that resemble human skulls. Its back is covered in long spikes. Its head resembles a goat skull, though it has a distinct lack of eyes and multiple twisting horns. Behind the beast is a humanoid wearing a welding mask that is struggling to pull it back with two long chains. ==Strategy== *Because of its high health, high damage per second and it only being usable once during a match, this is recommended to be only used against high health enemies, such as the [[Fallen King]]. *The '''Molten Monster''' can be summoned to deal with enemies that the current towers on the map cannot handle. However, it is recommended to not summon it too early as it will despawn if it eventually reaches the entrance of the map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MoltenMonsterIconIGBugged.png|'''Molten Monster''' on its Admin Panel icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Molten Monster''' is a revamped version of the [[Monster]], an unused unit that was meant to spawn on the final wave of [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] from the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. *The skeleton of a '''Molten Monster''' can be found in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *In [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] a '''Molten Monster''' would appear on the final wave as the '''Experiment #32'''. However, on top of this name change, it would also be listed as [[Professor V]]'s '''Experiment #32''', making it one of [[Professor V]]'s experiments. *The '''Molten Monster''' has the most health out of any non-admin unit in the game. **The [[Monster]], an admin-exclusive unit, has more health than it. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Molten Monster''' added. **{{Bug}} Footstep sounds are not affected by the [[Settings#Towers|Towers]] sound setting. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health decreased from 100,000 to 20,000. **[[Defense]] increased from 25% to 150%. **Swipe damage decreased from 1,000 to 600. **Fireball damage decreased from 2,500 to 1,500. *'''5 June 2025''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Swipe firerate decreased from 1.275 to 1.25 due to the [[Firerate Bug]] getting fixed. **Fireball firerate decreased from 8.025 to 8 due to the [[Firerate Bug]] getting fixed. *'''18 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0]] **Health increased from 20,000 to 25,000. **[[Defense]] increased from 150% to 200%. **Burn time decreased from 5 to 2.5. **Burn tick decreased from 1 to 0.5. {{TowerNavBox}}
